Sasquatch Park — Green Point day-use shore (Harrison Lake)

currentNotices: Provincial freshwater licence required; salmon (where present) is managed separately by DFO and must be confirmed same-day.
Waterbody-specific exceptions in the 2025–2027 Freshwater Fishing Regulations Synopsis apply. Confirm in-season variation orders before fishing.
Clean, Drain, Dry and pull the plug before moving any watercraft between waters.
Region 2 exception (MU 2-18): no wild trout over 50 cm; 1 bull trout over 60 cm; 10 km/h speed restriction at the south end as buoyed and signed.
Harrison Lake can raise high winds quickly. Swimmer’s itch may be present at Green Point.
No overnight parking at Green Point.
